title: FIRST SHADOW
hints: One Post explains all three marks.
Trace the three shadows back toward a common socket.
Their common origin is the center of the three directions.

title: OVERLAP
hints: A darker mark can have more than one cause.
Ask which two Posts could both contribute to B3.
Use the single shadows to pin those Posts down.

title: EMPTY SPEAKS
hints: Clear glass is evidence too.
A candidate Post must explain its shadows without creating new ones.
The dark center needs three causes, but the empty cells reject the wrong trio.

title: FOURTH LIGHT
hints: Something changed below the board.
The Post has not learned a new rule. The apparatus has.
Read the fourth shadow back toward its source.

title: TWO SOURCES
hints: The Post is already known. Reconstruct the illumination.
Each target mark points away from the source that made it.
Choose only the sources needed by these two directions.

title: LIGHT & POST
hints: Position and illumination can be solved together.
The double mark in the middle needs two opposing causes.
The absence of vertical traces constrains the lamps as strongly as the Posts.

title: SHUTTER
hints: The top lamp is lit, but one column behaves differently.
The metal plate interrupts only one light path.
Sideways shadows still survive in the blocked column.

title: TWO UNKNOWNS
hints: First separate object evidence from path evidence.
The side shadows can locate Posts without using the shutter.
Then move the plate to explain the missing downward trace.

title: LONG REACH
hints: The object itself has changed.
Follow one direction beyond the nearest cell.
Height is written into the reach of the shadow.

title: MIXED HEIGHTS
hints: Two objects can answer the same light differently.
Find which object must reach the far cells.
The darker C4 is shared by the tall and normal objects.

title: TURN THE PLATE
hints: The object can stay put and still change its answer.
Its broad face and thin edge do not meet light the same way.
Rotate the plate and watch which shadow axis survives.

title: CROSS SECTION
hints: One object answers every direction. One answers only two.
The full cross locates the ordinary Post.
Use the remaining pair and the overlap to orient the plate.

title: EDGE OR DARK?
hints: Not every missing shadow has the same cause.
Use the fixed round Post to identify which lamps are truly on.
Then let the plate's thin edge explain the remaining absence.

title: LONG & LIT
hints: The light pair and the object heights are entangled.
The two-cell reach must belong to the Tall Post.
Once height is fixed, the horizontal-only pattern tells you the two active lamps.

title: PLATE & SHUTTER
hints: One absence belongs to the shutter. Another belongs to the plate's thin edge.
Use the ordinary Post to read the blocked TOP path.
Then orient the plate from the two sideways shadows.

title: TWO AXES
hints: Two plates can point along different axes.
Pair each opposite shadow pair with its own midpoint.
The upper plate answers sideways. The lower plate answers vertically.

title: REACH & EDGE
hints: Long reach and directional reach are different signatures.
The long horizontal span belongs to the Tall Post.
The remaining vertical pair identifies the plate and its orientation.

title: LIGHT THROUGH A GAP
hints: Global darkness and local blockage leave different fingerprints.
The whole board tells you which one of four lamps is off.
Then use the missing TOP shadow from one column to seat the shutter.

title: THREE MATERIALS
hints: Three materials leave three different kinds of evidence.
Find the two-cell reach first, then the full one-cell cross.
What remains must be explained by the plate's allowed axis.

title: CALIBRATION
hints: Nothing here is new. Separate the causes you already know.
Reach identifies height. Local absence identifies the shutter. Directional absence identifies the plate.
Use those object clues to finish the three-light calibration.
